lines.en: After spending most of the day refusing to give up on something, Niki Nakayama’s rampage through the loves of her lover continued. Which made her view herself as either George, Lizzie, or Ralph.
If you haven’t been around very long, those names probably don’t mean anything to you. But those were the names given to the three main characters of the 1986 arcade game “Rampage” created by Midway.
It was the first video game Niki remembered playing — at an arcade she visited before Akira Arakawa ever even walked into her life.
She was different then, but not by much. She had a temper that hadn’t been tempered yet. And her rage would manifest internally as she hadn’t yet found someone worth aiming it at.
That’s probably why she took to Rampage immediately, for it’s a game where all you do is destroy. And it was a game she was actually  living now that everyone else felt like skyscrapers.

What she didn’t quite understand, however, was that there was someone else with so much of their formative identity tied up in a single concept that seeing outside of the lines would best be done with them covered by duct tape.
For the girl she had chased out here, that feeling was insignificance. Living under the shadow of some imposing mountain that always blocked out the sun when she most wanted to see it.
That’s why she moved to the opposite side — where the grass was greener and she could watch the sunrise every morning.
But she’d always known that the person she moved there with would become homesick one day. That he’d tire of the sunrise and how it burns his skin, then seek out the darkness once more.
Maya Makinami did not have a 1986 arcade cabinet with which to quell her rage, though. So she settled for the next best thing.
A girl who looked like the girl she wanted to hate. One who faced the same struggles she did, but with an added layer of difficulty at the hands that tightened familial ties.
It was easier to project her insecurities over someone just as small. Someone she had already surpassed. So she just kept doing it.
But there was always an element of fear to that when the shadow Maya feared most was not just hovering behind her newfound rival, but attached to her instead.
Noriko was the omen. She signaled the end of days without even knowing it. She signaled the sheer possibility that they may come. But now those days were upon us. Upon her.
And yet she still couldn’t face them. And no amount of emphasizing her best qualities could ever change that, so they were all just swallowed by the mountain’s darkness.
She looks out at a wall within a wall and wonders if it would feel the same if only walls could think.
But if they could, would they too get lost in thoughts like this when there’s so much more on the outside than there is here?
That thought ended prematurely. As would she under the watchful eyes of an encroaching moon.
: Want an autograph? I brought a pen.
: Did he put you up to this? Or do you just take joy in asserting superiority over vulnerable teenage girls?
: He told me not to talk to you, actually. Something about you being “different,” whatever that means.
: And yet you’ve come here of your own volition. To make me feel weak so that you will feel stronger and better about falling for a serial adulterer.
: Kind of, yeah.

: Well, then you can take solace in knowing that you don’t need to talk to me in order to do that. I’ve been second to you for as long as I’ve known him. And I’ll stay that way until he finally decides to leave me.
: You’re friends with Ami, aren’t you? I’ve seen you at the house before.
: It was better before you were there.
: Is that why you ran away during Christmalloween a couple years back? You were having so much fun that you couldn’t contain your joy and it all exploded out of you like some sort of supernova?
: How nice of you to remember me.
: I read all of the Haruhi books. I’d remember her anywhere.
: Then go back inside and remember her there. You have nothing to gain here if your only purpose is to make me feel terrible about myself.
: I wouldn’t say that’s my purpose. It’s more of just a bonus. And I bet half of the people sleeping with Akira right now wouldn’t be if they’d known how he is from the start.

: You do seem different, though. Like a...less pink Noriko. The kind of girl who fights a losing battle with her head held high out of desperation or forced optimism or whatever it is that keeps you going.
: What do you think he sees in you, exactly? Emotionally, I mean. You’re obviously very cute.
: I used to think it was salvation. I’m not sure if that’s the case anymore, though.
: Are you saying you think he’s been saved already? Or just beyond saving?
: Anyone who thinks he can be “saved” doesn’t understand him at all.
: Guess it all depends on what definition of “saved” you’re using.
: Like, I don’t think he’ll ever be happy with who he is and what he’s done, but I do think it’s possible that he lives a fulfilling and enjoyable life without fucking things up even more.
: Is that your master plan then? Get him to give everyone else up so he can live a “fulfilling and enjoyable” life with you?
: I don’t really know what my plan is, honestly.
: I wanted to avoid him a little while longer after catching him fucking my little sister, but I’m just as pathetic as the rest of you at the end of the day.
: I’m not sure why, but I just can’t give up on him. Some sort of childhood friend obligation or something, maybe. What’s the case for you?
: What do you mean?
: I mean why do you seem so attached to him when you’ve only known him for a few years?
: You know nothing about how long I’ve known him.
: Right, but even if he was in the fucking room when you were born, I’ve still known him longer. It’s probably just sunk cost fallacy keeping me going at this point. Why you, though?
: Especially now. This obviously isn’t the fairytale romance you were led to believe it was.
: It’s never been a fairytale. But...it was better. Before you came back. Before your sister came back. Before anyone else was fighting for him at all.
: Are you saying you’re ground zero then? Is that why he called you different?
: Well, that’s annoying. When? How old were you?
: I’m not going to answer that question.
: You’re barely answering any of my questions. I-
: I have no reason to. You already won. And I’m not going to give you the satisfaction of leeching further joy from how miserable and hopeless I feel in your presence.
: But you’re not going to back down either, are you? Which means I haven’t exactly “won,” have I?
: You’ve won as much as anyone can win with him. And if you lined the two of us up and forced him to choose, I am well aware that I’d be leaving here empty-handed.
: Hey, you’re more confident than me then. I’m pretty sure that basically half of the people I’ve talked to over the last couple days had sex with Akira before I did.
: And you’re probably right...but that’s not as important as you might think. Or...how I thought for a while.
: I’m not really in the mood for an anecdote about your experiences as a teenager struggling to take a footlong dick, thanks.
: If you’re going to fucking talk to me, will you at least hear me?! Because I might just be another stupid kid to you, but I’ve been dreading this confrontation for years!
: And all you’re doing is just making it feel like I’m part of some to-do list where you go through a lineup of all the girls fucking your boyfriend and say, “Please stop, for I am better.”
: Okay. Then please do give me the anecdote about you struggling to take a footlong dick. I would very much love to hear it.

: He could be a fucking eunuch for all I care! All I want is for him to look at me the way he used to! But every fucking day, that dream gets bigger and more distant because people like you keep blocking out the fucking sun!
: Blocking out the sun? You think we have access to the fucking sun? Here? In a world where we’re all fighting over the same broken sexpest who has never given any of us anything?
: Never given us anything?! He has given me everything! These clothes! My bell! A place to sleep! And he did it all without your help! Just like he can do for Ami!
: Everything I am is because of him! So of course I’m going to continue to love him even when I’m losing! There’s no alternative! It’s always just been him!

: And I thought that out of everyone, you would get that! But instead, I’m just exactly what I thought I’ve been to you this entire time! Another bump in the road that you’re too distracted to even notice!
: Do you have any idea how much I fear you?! The dread that seeps into every minute of every day?! Every second I spend without a response to my messages or calls?!
: It all goes back to you, Niki! But I bet you don’t even fucking know my name! And why would you when I was supposed to be a secret?!

: But now you’re posting pictures on fucking Instagram and bragging about the “love of your life” to the entire world like you’re the lead in a fucking rom-com when my entire world is just psychological horror and drama!
: Aren’t you supposed to be good?! Or at least good for him?! And not some fucking tsundere robot who shows up and just shits on him and everyone else so you can regain control of your life?!
: Never given us anything?! Really?! You’re going to take him back as easily as you did and then say something like that?! Would it kill you to be fucking honest with yourself?!
: It almost did once. When he ran away without even sparing me a warning. But that’s not information you’re going to find when you look me up online.
: He ran away to save you! From this! So don’t blame him now that you’re back and things fucking suck! Of course they suck! They were always going to suck the moment Ami’s mom died!
: So you know about her too then?
: I know everything...
: I’m ground zero.
: And you can look at me as the catalyst to all of this if you want. That’s what everyone has been fucking doing lately. Probably Akira too.
: But put yourself in my shoes. Imagine having nothing. Being nothing.
: And then suddenly...there’s this lonely, desperate man, barely clinging to life, who still manages to reach out and help you because, beneath all of the pain and suffering, he wants to be good.
: He wants to love and be loved, but doesn’t know how because it all just hurts so much when it goes away. And it does go away. We’ve seen it with our own eyes and felt it in our hearts.
: You’re making him sound like some sort of saint. He’s a terrible man who needs help and we both know it.
: We do. But the difference between you and me is that I only insult him to his face and you just want someone to validate you and make you feel like you haven’t wasted your entire life.
: So you’re probably doing this to everybody. Not just me. Then going back to him and tightening his collar while he stands there just innocently wanting you to be by his side despite his flaws.
: He fucked my little sister. In front of me.
: He could fuck the entire city of Kumon-mi in front of me and I still wouldn’t give up on him the way you have!
: What?! Say something! Make me feel small again!
: Girls like you are seriously the worst.
: What?
: It should be so fucking easy to just show up and be like, “Hi, I’m Niki Nakayama. You’re a teenager that’s fucking my boyfriend and that’s gross and not cool.”
: But then girls like you or Noriko explain it in a way where it actually starts to make sense. That’s what sucks.
: You keep robbing me of reasons to lose faith in him and perpetuating the cycle where he and I wind up together and the rest of you feel bad.
: I...don’t really get it.
: Because you think I’ve actually given up on him. That the reason I’m going out of my way to talk to all of you is to try and make you all feel weak and stupid. And that’s not true.
: Well, I guess there’s an ounce of truth to it. But what I really want to do is-
: To figure out how things became the way they are...
: To see just how far he’s fallen and if there’s any hope for him at all.
: What I don’t get is the outcome you’re seeking. Do you want a reason to have faith in him? Or do you want a reason to lose it?
: Did he really take you in when you had nowhere else to go?
: I’m guessing you’re the one who made the first move too then, aren’t you?
: Did something give it away?
: Just the fact that it’s what I’d least want to hear.
: Then yes, I did. And I’d do it again too.
: Because no matter how terrible you make me feel and no matter how badly you will ultimately defeat me, he is the one I want.
: And he will stay that way until the end of time...
: What’s your name again?
: Maya. Maya Makinami.
: Have you ever considered becoming an idol?
: Not even once.
: Good. Don’t. You wouldn’t make it.
: Thank you for finally saying something nice to me. Can I take that as the conversation being over?
: No.
: There’s a konbini around the corner. How about I buy you a drink?
: I figure it’s the least I can do after making you live your life in fear for so long.
: And probably a good chance for me to learn some stuff about Ami that she wouldn’t tell me otherwise. If you’re actually willing to talk, that is.
: You’re...offering to buy me a drink?
: Yeah. You seem smart, so I figured you’d have picked up on that.
: That’s...not really the direction I thought this conversation was going in. You don’t think I like you, do you?
: No, and I don’t like you either. Do we really need to like each other to just go for a walk, though?
: I...guess not? But still, I-
: Come on. It’s not often I offer to buy someone a drink.
: Do you want a mask? So the paparazzi leave us alone?
: I...need to wear one too?
: Probably not. Wouldn’t hurt, though, right?
: Uhh...o...okay?
: I just...don’t you...isn’t Akira waiting for you inside?
: He’s probably forgotten all about me by now. I just hope he’s standing in the corner all sad instead of going against my orders again.
: Yeah, so? Making him wait is just my way of training him.
: He’s not your pet...
: You’re only saying that because you’re his.
: W...Willingly! You forgot to mention the “willingly” part!
: Just shut up and put this on.
Somehow or another, things ended up like this.
The game of Rampage ends with a building still standing — though whether that’s a glitch or a creative decision remains to be determined.
There is one thing for certain, though.
Maya Makinami still feels insignificant — for she would never offer up an olive branch like this. Nor would she take one from the other girl who lives in the shadow of the mountain.
For a moment, though, she feels regretful. Remorseful. And worse about herself than she has in a long time.
These feelings would only get worse over time.
There was only one war that ended tonight.
